subject: mathematics
content: Let the line $$l: x=\frac{1-y}{-2}=\frac{z-3}{\lambda}, \lambda \in \mathbb{R}$$ meet the plane $$P: x+2 y+3 z=4$$ at the point $$(\alpha, \beta, \gamma)$$. If the angle between the line $$l$$ and the plane $$P$$ is $$\cos ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\frac{5}{14}}\right)$$, then $$\alpha+2 \beta+6 \gamma$$ is equal to ___________.
